card.name: Start of units and table labels
card.fires_on: A single letter that begins a unit or table marker, such as the r in rads, e in eGFR, m in mL/min, or g in g/dL. It appears in dose tables, usually right after a number, an opening bracket or a column heading.

modes.label: Radiation dose units
modes.description: The r of rads right after an MBq amount or an opening bracket in absorbed-dose tables.
modes.example: Bone and Cardiac Imaging* Technetium Tc 99m Pyrophosphate Injection Target Organ mGy/555 MBq<< r>>ads/15 mCi Total Body

modes.label: Kidney and lab units in dosing tables
modes.description: The first letter of eGFR, mL/min or g/dL in column headings and brackets.

modes.label: Table footnote letters
modes.description: A lone letter used as a footnote marker after a table heading or row label.
modes.example: Phosphorus Dosage<< b>>, c Corresponding Potassium Content

card.plain: It fires on the first letter of a unit or footnote marker in dosing tables, such as the r in rads or the e in eGFR.
